primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒17:10で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
WEB固定版の使徒17:13で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article identifies Beroea as the ancient city now Veria in Macedonia and cites the Acts 17 visit.
